title: Se, They or One?
goal: Choose between se, a plural verb and uno, and use impersonal se with ser and estar.

items: I can choose between se, a plural verb and uno to say who is part of the statement.
I can use impersonal se with ser or estar and an adjective.
I can use the new words for moving away, missing people and looking after yourself.
